description: manaty/nexlink's prevalidation parts (scripts/test-parts.py: node, jest, sql): pinned Node 22 and a docker-to-rootless-podman shim cached once, npm ci of each tested package per job from the shared npm cache, scripts/sql-tests.sh containers in the job slice
setup:
mkdir -p "$OFFLOAD_CACHE/bin" "$OFFLOAD_CACHE/npm" "$OFFLOAD_CACHE/electron"
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '# nexlink scripts/sql-tests.sh calls docker: rootless podman, its run in the job slice, image volumes in tmpfs' '[ "$1" = run ] || exec podman "$@"' 'shift' 'exec podman run --image-volume=tmpfs ${OFFLOAD_SLICE:+--cgroup-parent "$OFFLOAD_SLICE"} "$@"' > "$OFFLOAD_CACHE/bin/docker"
chmod 0755 "$OFFLOAD_CACHE/bin/docker"
v=22.22.0; f=node-v$v-linux-x64.tar.xz
curl -fsSL -o "$TMPDIR/$f" "https://nodejs.org/dist/v$v/$f"
echo "9aa8e9d2298ab68c600bd6fb86a6c13bce11a4eca1ba9b39d79fa021755d7c37  $TMPDIR/$f" | sha256sum -c - >&2
mkdir "$OFFLOAD_CACHE/node"
tar -xJf "$TMPDIR/$f" -C "$OFFLOAD_CACHE/node" --strip-components=1
rm -f "$TMPDIR/$f"
before:
for d in backend website desktop mobile shared/*; do
  [ -f "$d/package-lock.json" ] || continue
  echo "nexlink: npm ci $d" >&2
  (cd "$d" && npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund) >&2
done
after: podman ps -aq --filter "label=nexlink.ci.owner=ameesh-job-$OFFLOAD_JOB" | xargs -r podman rm -f -v -t 2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
